stem.text: Two masses, $M$ and $m$, are connected by an inextensible string which passes over a frictionless pulley. Mass $M$ rests on a frictionless slope, as shown.

stem.alt: Pulley with a mass labelled m hanging vertically from one side and a mass labelled M on a slope, with the slope labelled frictionless slope and its angle labelled θ.

stem.text: The slope is at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal.
The two masses are initially held stationary and then released. Mass $M$ accelerates down the slope.
